'''Brandon Bale''' (also published as '''Brandon Bales''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Pleasanton tournament]] on 20 August 2000 with [[Local Uprising / Liberation|Raltiir Uprising (Operatives, speeders)]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1153">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ pleasonton-ca-9-20], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played Pleasanton-area tournaments through 2001, often with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]].<ref name="tr-d1762">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-22-pleasonton-2-17-01d1762/ pleasonton-2-17-01], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 22 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-22-pleasonton-2-17-01d1762/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
